items.summary: A police officer who shot a Black man in the head during an attempted arrest in Mississauga, Ont., nearly seven years ago told a coroner’s inquest Tuesday that he did not make a conscious decision to open fire but instead acted out of a ‘fight-or-flight’ instinct.
